background: Erste Group is an Austrian bank with the leading retail franchise across Central and Eastern Europe, funded by local deposits in Austria, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania, Hungary and Croatia, and part-owned by its founding savings-bank foundation.
synthesis: Erste is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, two on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 21 Apr 2026. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic banks: leverage of 6.4% is above the peer median, but CET1 of 14.4% is below it, and since 30 Jun 2024 CET1 has fallen 1.1 points and leverage 0.8 points. Liquidity is mixed too, with NSFR of 137% in the top quarter despite having fallen 7 points since 30 Jun 2025, and LCR of 149% just below the peer median (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The item flagged on 29 Sep 2026 is the risk of a sovereign downgrade for Romania, one of the group's main markets.
